verdict.rationale: Fastmail's Filters & Rules run autonomously in the background (server-side, no manual trigger needed) and JMAP's push/EventSource plus token-based API access give developers the building blocks to hook external automations/agents into an account, but there's no dedicated 'AI automation' or agent-scripting feature, and JMAP is discovery/session infra rather than a workflow-automation platform. Missing for 10: a first-party AI/agent automation feature or documented workflow builder, evidence of scheduled/triggered custom scripts beyond mail filters, and independent confirmation of autonomous agent use via the API.
